causal_question: Does replacing only execution-context local-slot LinkedHashMap storage with a private array-backed representation produce a large causal reduction capable of explaining a dominant part of PERF010-A?

interpretation_rule.small_or_moderate: If all workload medians are positive but remain below multiplicative scale, close as REAL_COST_BUT_NOT_THE_BIG_COST.
interpretation_rule.no_clear_effect: If the four-workload matrix does not show a clear positive causal signal, close as NO_MATERIAL_CAUSAL_EFFECT.
interpretation_rule.multiplicative: Only coherent approximately >=2x improvement keeps the candidate possible and authorizes a later external baseline.
interpretation_rule.order_of_magnitude: Only coherent approximately >=10x improvement is order-of-magnitude relevant.
